name: Creatures
description:
Rebalanced creatures:

1) Orc Chieftain - damage range increased to 3 - 6.
2) Ice Elemental - no melee penalty
3) Fire and Energy Elemental - damage range increased to 6 - 8
4) Earth and Magma Elemental - HP, attack, defense and damage range increased
5) Zealot - can cast advanced Bless
6) Firebird and Phoenix - increased cost. Firebirds have 50% reduction of damage from Fire Magic spells.
7) Ballista - increased damage and cost decreased to 1500.

Creatures with changed AI value:

Monk, Naga, Scorpicore, Red Dragon, Efreet Sultan, Ghost Dragon, Lizardman, Lizard Warrior, Cyclop King, Firebird, Faerie Dragon, Ice/Fire/Energy/Earth/Magma Elemental.
